issue.title: Pin the property-card title-block actions to the kicker row so they stop wrapping under the dek at narrow widths

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-qp.7 (note #6, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-qp land agent.

At narrow pane widths (about 420px and below), the shared title-block actions row from the property-card kit (240g-plugin-property-card-title-block-dom.js: the fold toggle and its siblings) wraps onto its own line beneath the dek on every family card: album, record, day/period, bank, area, project, notebook, prose, and ref. qp.7's light/dark narrow screenshot matrix shows this; the screenshots were approved because the layout is readable, not because it is right. Pin the actions to the kicker row (right-aligned, no wrap) so the title and dek keep the full width. Re-run the family screenshot matrix (light/dark, narrow/wide, LP/Reading, forced-colors) before and after. Evidence: the qp.7 screenshots in file:explicit:4f6ec6de1f7e3ef296d67c86.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The title-block layout is shared kit code that serves every family card. The Ref Cards epic accepted the existing narrow layout rather than restyling the whole family mid-flight beside bob-cli-qm and bob-cli-qq.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-qp.7's narrow screenshot review showed the shared kit's fold/actions row wrapping beneath the dek on every family card, a family-wide layout issue outside the Ref Cards scope.
